CDM Project Design Document Form
Title of the project activity: Nyota Small Hydro Project
Host Party: Uganda
Project participants: Nyota Hydro Ltd.
Applied methodology: ACM0002 Version 20.0

1.1 General description of project activity
The project activity is a run-of-river hydro facility connected to the national grid.

1.2 Project location
The project is located in Kasese District, Uganda.

2.1 Baseline scenario
The baseline scenario is continued reliance on the regional fossil-fuel-dominated electricity grid.

2.2 Additionality
The project is additional because the hydro plant is not financially viable without carbon revenue.

3.1 Leakage
Leakage is not expected because the project does not displace existing activities outside the site boundary.

4.1 Monitoring plan
Monitoring will track grid electricity generation, meter readings, and plant availability monthly.
